description: Returns the specified Enumeration from the Project context. Scope: one project (requires a project ID). To act across all projects, use `getGlobalEnumeration` instead. Cardinality: targets a single item by ID. For the full collection or a batch, use `getProjectEnumerations` instead. Examples: {"projectId":"myproject","enumContext":"workitems","enumName":"status","targetType":"requirement"}. Selection: Use getProjectEnumeration for values configured in one project; use getGlobalEnumeration for global enumeration values.

enumContext.description: The Enumeration context. (Allowed values are '~', 'plans', 'testing' and 'documents'. Use '~' for Work Item or general enumerations.)

additionalProperties.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include for this resource type

fields.description: Sparse fieldset selector: an object keyed by resource type (e.g. `workitems`) whose value is a comma-separated list of attribute names to return (e.g. `id,title,status`), reducing payload size. Omit to return the default field set.

include.description: Comma-separated list of related resource types to embed in the response (e.g. `author,attachments`) so they don't require a separate follow-up call. Omit to return only the primary resource.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

targetType.description: The configured subtype for this enumeration or custom field (e.g. `requirement` for a Work Item type). Use `~` (without quotes) when the configuration applies to every subtype.

name: getProjectEnumeration

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

parameter.description: String indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

status.description: HTTP status code applicable to this problem.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.
